summary.title: Budget summary
summary.barLabel: Paid: {{paid}}. Pending: {{pending}}. Planned in total: {{percent}}% of the budget.
summary.overNote: What you've planned goes over the total: a good moment to calmly rebalance a few items.
summary.withinNote: Between actual and planned amounts you are at {{percent}}% of the total. You are within your budget.
summary.noTotal: You haven't set a total budget yet.

tiles.deviationMore: above plan on items with an actual amount
tiles.deviationLess: below plan on items with an actual amount
tiles.deviationSame: exactly as planned on items with an actual amount

breakdown.title: By category
breakdown.note: Expected = the actual amount where you know it and the planned one for the rest. Deviation is actual minus planned. The percentage is of the total expected.
breakdown.noteWithAllocation: Expected = the actual amount where you know it and the planned one for the rest. It is compared with what you allocated to each category.
breakdown.aboveAllocation: Above the allocation by {{amount}}; you can adjust the split at your own pace.
breakdown.noItemsYet: No items in this category yet.

errors.customCategory: Enter your category name or choose one from the list.
errors.category: Choose a category or create your own.

form.duePlaceholder: When does it need to be paid?
form.actualHint: Once you know the real cost (signed quote, invoice), add it: it will count instead of the planned amount.
form.vendorHint: Link it to a vendor to see what is paid and pending on their page.

installments.sumOk: The instalments add up to the amount.
installments.sumHint: The instalments add up to {{sum}} of {{cost}}.

list.title: Budget
list.description: What you've already paid, what's left to pay and how much budget you have to spare.
list.markPaidError: We couldn't mark it as paid. Please try again.

empty.title: No expenses recorded yet
empty.text: Record each expense with its amount and mark it as paid or pending, so you'll always know how much you've paid and how much is left. You can start with the biggest ones: the venue or the catering.

list.unmarkInstallmentAria: Undo the payment of instalment {{n}} of "{{name}}"
list.remainingNoInstallment: {{amount}} still has no instalment: edit the item to add another one.

banquet.hint: Usually the biggest item: it multiplies with every guest.

venueSpace.hint: Some venues already include furniture and a menu; others charge separately.

photoVideo.hint: You pay once and keep it forever: don't cut it back too much.

musicDance.hint: Check whether the open bar is paid separately or included in the catering.

concepts.0: DJ or band for the party

beauty.hint: Ask for a price that includes travel if you want them to come to the wedding location.

concepts.3: Hair for the maid of honor and family
Gift for parents and the wedding party

honeymoon.hint: If you've already saved for it separately, you can spread this % across other items.

concepts.1: Donation to the parish or officiant

contingency.hint: Setting it aside from the start avoids surprises at the end.

ideas.title: Ideas for your budget
ideas.descriptionWithTotal: A suggested split of your budget. Each item is created with an estimated amount that you can change.
ideas.descriptionNoTotal: Typical items with their suggested %. If you set your total budget in the plan, you'll see the amounts too.
ideas.empty: You already have all the usual items.

addAll.confirmWithTotal: {{number}} items will be created with the estimated amount based on your total budget. You can edit them afterwards.
addAll.confirmNoTotal: {{number}} items will be created without an amount; you can fill it in and edit them afterwards.

payers.title: Who pays
payers.note: How much falls to each payer, based on the items that have someone assigned.
payers.noneAssigned: You have not said who pays each item yet. Edit an item and choose the payer: the summary will appear here.
payers.editHint: Give each payer the name you like (for example "Marta's family"). Leave it empty to use the default name.
payers.saveError: The names could not be saved.

allocation.title: Split the budget by category
allocation.description: Decide how much you want to spend on each thing. We start from a typical split for weddings in Spain; adjust it to your needs.
allocation.above: You have allocated {{amount}} more than the total; adjust whatever you like.
allocation.assignedNoTotal: Allocated: {{assigned}}. Enter the total budget to see how much is left.
allocation.typicalNote: The typical split is a guide for an average wedding in Spain. On the Budget tab you will see each category compared with the planned and actual amounts.
allocation.saveError: The split could not be saved.

errors.needTotal: Enter the total budget to split by percentage.

vendorSummary.title: Budget and payments
vendorSummary.empty: No budget expenses are linked to this vendor yet.
vendorSummary.emptyWithCost: No expenses linked yet. Price on the vendor page: {{amount}}.
